_doc: House price feature settings. Edit values here, not in code.

price_adjustment._doc: The listings are from 2024. Model prices are multiplied by 'factor' to show current prices. Update every quarter from NHB RESIDEX (https://residex.nhbonline.org.in/) or measure it from recent listings.
price_adjustment.basis: NHB RESIDEX Pune +4.6% YoY to Sep 2025 (official) x assumed +3.8% to Oct 2026 (3.5% per year, latest Pune rate)

cleaning._doc: Step 3 rules. Rows breaking a 'remove' rule are dropped; 'blank' rules empty one value but keep the row.

features._doc: Step 4 settings. Landmark coordinates are approximate (checked against the median coordinates of listings in that locality).

split._doc: Step 5. test_size = share of rows kept aside for the final test. Rows are split so both parts have the same mix of cheap and costly flats (price_bins).

models._doc: Step 6. Models compared with cross-validation on the TRAIN rows only (the test rows are not touched until step 8).

lightgbm_tuned._note: Saved settings rechecked on grouped 5-fold CV: MAE 18.35 lakh, RMSE 38.82 lakh, MAPE 14.47%; step 6 settings: MAE 18.94 lakh, RMSE 40.02 lakh, MAPE 14.81%. Earlier random-row search metrics are not comparable.

tuning._doc: Step 7. Random search: try n_trials random combinations of the LightGBM settings below, each scored with the same 5-fold cross-validation on train.csv. The best settings are written to models.lightgbm_tuned.

evaluation._doc: Step 8. Models are trained on ALL of train.csv and scored ONCE on test.csv. Price bands are in INR lakh.

explain._doc: Step 9. Explains the tuned LightGBM. Inputs are grouped into what the user types in the app (area, rooms, floors, region) plus 'other'.

price_range._doc: Step 10. Two extra LightGBM models predict a low and a high price (quantile regression). Their gap is then calibrated with 5-fold cross-validation on train.csv so that 'coverage' of real prices fall inside the range. test.csv is only used to check the result.

final_model._doc: Step 11. The final models are trained once on ALL clean flats (train + test) and saved to models/. The price range is re-calibrated on all flats with the step 10 method.

defaults._doc: Used when the user leaves an input empty.
